component.name: ROMarr
component.summary: Request, find and organize your game library

description.p: ROMarr is the *arr for games. Ask for a title and ROMarr searches the indexers you configure, hands the best release to your download client, checks what arrived and files it into your game library, laid out the way your emulator frontend expects.

Releases are ranked for games rather than video: region, revision and verified dumps count, prototypes, hacks and cross-console mismatches are rejected, and every score shows its reasoning so a wrong pick is one click to correct.

ul.li: Works with Prowlarr, qBittorrent, SABnzbd and NZBGet you already run
Files into RomM, Gaseous, Retrom, or a plain folder tree for ES-DE, EmuDeck, RetroDECK, RetroArch and LaunchBox
Verifies archives against No-Intro and Redump DATs and audits your existing library
Runs locally: the server listens on this computer only and keeps its data in your home folder

description.p: ROMarr does not include any games or BIOS files. Use it with content you have the right to download.

screenshot.caption: Interactive search with the reasoning behind every score

ul.li: Reports and Help: review a suspicious library file, keep scanner evidence with its SHA-256, quarantine or restore it
Library audits verify ordinary ZIPs against the ROMs inside while arcade sets keep container verification
Indexer Retry-After cooldowns, configurable timeouts and responsive tables
